records.title: FORM 10-Q Q2 2022
records.text: Net revenues increased by 68%, or $214.1 million, in the three months ended June 30, 2022, as compared to the same period in 2021, driven primarily by a 42% increase in microinverter units volume shipped and a 205% increase in Enphase IQ Battery Megawatt-hour (“MWh”) shipped.

records.title: FORM 10-Q Q2 2022
records.text: Due to increased demand across a range of industries, the global supply chain and the semiconductor industry have experienced significant disruptions in recent periods.

records.title: FORM 10-Q Q2 2022
records.text: We have seen supply chain challenges and logistics constraints increase, including component shortages, which have, in certain cases, caused delays in critical components and inventory, longer lead times, and have resulted in increased costs.

records.title: FORM 10-Q Q2 2022
records.text: In addition, the impact of inflation on the price of components, raw materials and labor has increased.

records.title: FORM 10-Q Q2 2022
records.text: Our cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities decreased by $64.5 million in the six months ended June 30, 2022, compared to the same period in 2021, primarily due to use of cash to fund acquisitions, repurchase shares of our common stock, make investments in private companies, and make payments of withholding taxes related to net share settlement of equity awards, partially offset by cash generated from operations.
